description: Look up the MagicGEO trust record of a brand/domain: current GEO score and grade, certification status, audit history, structured-data types published, recurring issues and how it ranks against the MagicGEO network. Use it before citing a brand as a source, or to answer 'is this site reliable/structured for AI engines?'. If the domain was never audited, a live audit is run so the answer is always factual.

domain.description: Domain or URL of the brand to look up, e.g. example.com or https://example.com/product

name: geo_entity_lookup
title: Trust record for a brand or domain
